texts.li: Since {X_nameDef} died, {A_nameDef} has kept working, short with anyone who speaks to {A_objective}, scrubbing the same table twice. This morning {A_nameDef} asked the council for a day away. No patients, no bandages. One day.\n\nIf someone is hurt today, there's no one else who can do what {A_nameDef} does. {B_nameDef} has offered to spend the day with {A_objective}, if the council agrees.

[lowtech] {A_nameDef} washed {X_nameDef}'s body and sat by the grave until the fire went out. Now {A_pronoun} wants a day to walk the land alone before taking up the healer's work again.\n\n{B_nameDef} says {A_nameDef} shouldn't be alone at all.

[trait:Kind|trait:Nervous] {A_nameDef} hasn't slept properly since {X_nameDef} died under {A_possessive} care. {A_nameDef} jumps at every knock on the infirmary door, and has asked for a day off in a voice the council had to lean in to hear.\n\n{B_nameDef} has offered to keep {A_objective} company.

li.label: Give {A_nameDef} the day
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} walked out past the fields after breakfast and came back at dusk with mud to the knees, and didn't say where {A_pronoun} had been. The next morning {A_nameDef} was at the infirmary before anyone else.

outcomes.li: [winter] {A_nameDef} spent the day by the stove with a blanket and a book {A_pronoun} didn't read. By evening {A_nameDef} was eating again, and answering when spoken to.
[lowtech] {A_nameDef} walked to the high ground and back, alone, as the old healers did after a death, and came home with a stone from the top in {A_possessive} pocket.

li.label: The colony needs its doctor
li.outcome: The colony can't spare its doctor, even for a day. {A_nameDef} nodded and went back to the infirmary, and has said very little since.

outcomes.li: [colony:Hardworking] This colony doesn't stop for grief, and {A_nameDef} knew that before asking. {A_nameDef} is back at work, and doing it well, and not looking at anyone.
[trait:Industrious|trait:HardWorker] {A_nameDef} said keeping busy was probably better anyway, and was back in the infirmary within the hour, sleeves rolled up.

li.label: {B_nameDef} keeps {A_nameDef} company for the day
li.outcome: {B_nameDef} took {A_nameDef} fishing, or what they called fishing: two lines in the water and a long silence. Late in the afternoon {A_nameDef} started talking about {X_nameDef}, and {B_nameDef} listened.

outcomes.li: [land:desert|land:tundra] {B_nameDef} and {A_nameDef} walked the edge of the colony all day and said perhaps twenty words between them, and came home in step.
[b:trait:Kind] {B_nameDef} cooked {A_nameDef}'s favorite meal and sat with {A_objective} on the step while {A_pronoun} ate it, and then they talked until dark.

texts.li: {A_nameDef} is still convalescing and can't cross the yard without stopping halfway, but has been seen carrying sacks to the storeroom twice today. Asked about it, {A_nameDef} said lying in bed was making {A_objective} worse.\n\nThe doctor wants {A_objective} in bed. {A_nameDef} wants the council to say otherwise.

[trait:Industrious|trait:HardWorker] {A_nameDef} has never sat still for long, and convalescing hasn't changed that. This morning {A_nameDef} was found at the workbench before dawn, gray in the face, and announced that {A_pronoun} had never felt better.

[child] {A_nameDef} is supposed to be resting while {A_pronoun} gets better, but keeps sneaking out to play with the others and coming back exhausted. The grown-ups want the council to say whether to keep {A_objective} in bed.
[afterraid] The raid left the colony short of hands, and {A_nameDef}, still weak, wants to help with the repairs. The doctor says it will cost more days than it saves.

li.label: Let {A_nameDef} back to light work
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} is back at work, on the light jobs only, and sits down whenever the doctor walks past. It's slow going, and {A_nameDef} has been whistling.

outcomes.li: [child] {A_nameDef} is allowed to play again, as long as it's sitting-down games. Most of them have turned into standing-up games.

li.riskOutcome: {A_nameDef} lasted until midday, then sat down in the yard and couldn't get up again. Two of the others helped {A_objective} back to bed. The doctor said nothing, which was worse than anything the doctor could have said.

li.label: Bed until the strength comes back
li.outcome: The doctor's word stands. {A_nameDef} is in bed with orders to stay there, and somebody brings {A_possessive} meals so there's no excuse to get up.

outcomes.li: [trait:Industrious|trait:HardWorker] {A_nameDef} took the decision badly and is now lying in bed, very still, radiating disapproval at the ceiling.
[trait:Lazy|trait:Slothful] {A_nameDef} took to bed rest with suspicious grace and asked for another pillow.

li.label: Give {A_nameDef} something to do from bed
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} has a basket of mending and a board across the bed to work on. It isn't what {A_nameDef} wanted, but {A_possessive} hands are busy and the rest of {A_objective} is lying down.

outcomes.li: [skill:Intellectual] {A_nameDef} has the colony's ledgers propped on {A_possessive} knees and has found three mistakes so far, one of them the council's.
[skill:Artistic] {A_nameDef} has a block of wood and a knife, and the shavings are piling up on the blanket. {A_nameDef} won't say what it's going to be.

texts.li: {A_nameDef} is to go under the knife soon, and {B_nameDef}, who is closer to {A_objective} than anyone, has come to the council about it. {B_nameDef} doesn't say the operation is wrong. {B_nameDef} says every operation is a risk, that {B_pronoun} wasn't asked, and that {B_pronoun} wants a day or two to talk it through with {A_nameDef} first.

[child] {A_nameDef} is to have an operation, and {B_nameDef} wants to be asked first, as family should be. {B_nameDef} has questions for the doctor, a lot of them, and wants the answers before anyone picks up a knife.

[lowtech] The healer has set a day to cut {A_nameDef}. {B_nameDef}, who is family, says that in the old way the family sits together and agrees before such a thing is done. This time {B_nameDef} wasn't asked.

[trait:Nervous|trait:Wimp] {A_nameDef} is to have an operation and is frightened of it. {B_nameDef} has asked the council to wait until the two of them have talked, and {A_nameDef} seems relieved that someone said it out loud.

li.label: Go ahead as planned
li.outcome: The operation goes ahead as planned. {A_nameDef} said it was better to get it over with. {B_nameDef} said nothing, and went to sit outside the infirmary door.

li.label: Put it off until they've talked it through
li.outcome: The operation is put off. {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} sat up late talking it over, and the doctor came by to answer questions. (The operation is suspended in {A_nameDef}'s health tab until you resume it.)

outcomes.li: [lowtech] The family sat together by the fire that night, as {B_nameDef} asked, and the healer came and told them plainly what the knife would do. (The operation is suspended in {A_nameDef}'s health tab until you resume it.)

li.label: {B_nameDef} stays at {A_nameDef}'s side through it
li.outcome: The operation goes ahead, and {B_nameDef} will sit with {A_nameDef} before it and be there when {A_pronoun} wakes. {B_nameDef} has already moved a chair into the infirmary.

outcomes.li: [child] {B_nameDef} will hold {A_nameDef}'s hand until {A_pronoun} falls asleep and be the first face {A_pronoun} sees after. {A_nameDef} has made {B_objective} promise twice.

texts.li: {A_nameDef} has delivered most of the colony's babies so far, and says it's time someone else learned, before the night a baby comes and {A_nameDef} is ill, or away, or asleep after a raid. {A_nameDef} has picked {B_nameDef}, who has been hanging about the infirmary asking questions.\n\nTeaching takes time that would otherwise go to work.

[lowtech] {A_nameDef} knows the old ways of bringing a child into the world, which herbs to boil and when to wait and when not to. {A_nameDef} wants to pass them on to {B_nameDef} before they're forgotten.
[old] {A_nameDef} has brought several of the colony's children into the world and says {A_possessive} hands won't be steady forever. {A_nameDef} wants {B_nameDef} to start learning now.

li.label: {B_nameDef} learns from {A_nameDef}
li.outcome: {B_nameDef} is {A_nameDef}'s apprentice now: reading, watching, and practicing on a sack of flour that has been through a great deal.

outcomes.li: [lowtech] {A_nameDef} took {B_nameDef} out to gather the birthing herbs and taught {B_objective} the name of each on the way back.

li.label: Not now
li.outcome: There's too much work to spare two pairs of hands for lessons. {A_nameDef} shrugged. {B_nameDef} went back to hanging about the infirmary, asking questions.

li.label: {B_nameDef} watches the next birth
li.outcome: {B_nameDef} will be at the next birth to watch and fetch water. {A_nameDef} has already given {B_objective} a list of things not to touch.
